# Mochi：給 Gridfiti 編輯的英文 press note（mochi-05）

| 項目 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 用途 | 請 Gridfiti 編輯評估，日後寫 aesthetic／cute to-do list、aesthetic Home Screen 類清單文時，把 Mochi 當成候選之一。只是提供資訊：不付費、不交換任何東西、不要求回覆 |
| 發在哪／給誰 | Gridfiti（gridfiti.com）編輯。只用網站 Contact／About／投稿頁上公開的官方信箱或表單；找不到官方管道就不寄。不要猜信箱，不要私訊作者的個人社群帳號 |
| 發文者 | 店主 Guan Feng Lai 本人，用自己的信箱寄，署名 Lumi Studio；信中已寫明是開發者本人 |
| 發文規則 | 只寄一次，不追信、不催；兩週沒回就當作不適合。附 3–4 張真實截圖（免費主題和 Premium 主題都要有，檔名或圖說標明 free／Premium）。不提排名、評分數、「best／#1」，不提其他 App 的名字。不提供任何「收錄就送…」的條件 |
| 事實依據 | en-US 商店文案（`_engine/data/mochi_full.json`）：101 款主題（5 款免費、96 款 Premium）、11 組表情符號（免費 1 組）、主畫面小工具、Apple Watch App、提醒、每日計畫、習慣與例行、購物清單與筆記；免費版 2 個清單、每清單最多 4 項；Premium 是 App 內購買。50 種介面語言、App 內切換（店主確認） |
| 不能寫 | 「one-time／pay once／no subscription」：商店文案只寫「an in-app purchase」，是否一次買斷還沒確認（見 mochi-01）。確認後才能在 Pricing 段加一句。也不能寫「free, no ads」這種會讓人以為完整功能都免費的說法 |
| 連結 | https://apps.apple.com/app/id6785004775?pt=118326163&ct=mochi_press_gridfiti&mt=8 |

---

## 寄出用內文

**Subject:** Indie app for an aesthetic to-do list roundup: Mochi (cute checklist for iPhone + Apple Watch)

```text
Hi Gridfiti team,

I'm Guan Feng Lai, a solo iOS developer in Taiwan (Lumi Studio). I'm writing because Gridfiti covers aesthetic iPhone setups, and I built a to-do app with exactly that kind of Home Screen in mind: Mochi: Cute Checklist.

In one line: a cute, cozy checklist where you tap a little circle when a task is done.

What might fit an aesthetic to-do list roundup:
- 101 themes (5 free, 96 with Premium) and 11 emoji sets (1 free)
- Home Screen widgets, so your list matches the rest of your setup
- An Apple Watch app to check your list from your wrist
- Reminders, a daily planner, habits and routines, grocery lists and notes in one place
- 50 interface languages you can switch inside the app, without changing your iPhone's language (only the app's interface changes; what you type is never translated)

An honest note on pricing, so your readers aren't surprised: the free version is small. It includes 2 lists with up to 4 tasks each, 5 themes and 1 emoji set. Premium is an in-app purchase that unlocks unlimited lists and tasks, all 101 themes and all 11 emoji sets.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6785004775?pt=118326163&ct=mochi_press_gridfiti&mt=8

I've attached a few screenshots (each one labeled free or Premium). If it helps, I can also send full-resolution images of more themes or a short screen recording.

There's no payment involved and no need to reply. If it doesn't fit what you cover, no worries at all.

Thank you for your time,
Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio, independent developer in Taiwan
```
